 MVP Chase McLaughlin
 November 1st, 2026 
 The sweet smell of perfection can be found in the Buccaneers locker room. No, it’s not an odd body odor fetish. 
 Buccaneers kicker Chase McLaughlin is a perfect 19-0f-19 on field goal attempts this season. He made three today in wet conditions during the Bucs’ 16-0 blanking of Arthur Blank’s Falcons.
 Notice how the Falcons missed their opening-drive field goal from 53 yards? That was former Bucs kicker Nick Folk doing the honors. If Atlanta makes that kick, perhaps it’s a different ballgame.
 McLaughlin made kicks of 46, 34 and 42 yards.
 Back in 2023, his first Bucs season, McLaughlin made 29 of 31 field goals (93.5 percent), a franchise record. He also was perfec on extra points.
 It seems McLaughlin is back on a record-breaking path. One could argue he’s been the Bucs’ most lethal weapon.
